rows.description: A teenager who understands a topic well explains it too quickly and with jargon, then thinks the listener is slow. Knowledge makes it hard to see the beginner's view.

rows.description: A young child remembers the one time he was scolded more strongly than the many times he was praised. Painful moments feel heavier and stick longer.
